purpose: Four illustrative Why CHW process scenes

products.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: a square editorial photograph for one point in a B2B Indian healthcare manufacturer's landing page.
Create one extremely realistic professional commercial photograph, 1:1 SQUARE composition. Documentary realism, not a 3D render, not an illustration, not a diagram. Genuine materials, natural shadows, plausible human anatomy and workplace arrangements, restrained colour grading. White, soft sage, forest green, natural kraft and stainless steel colour family. Beautiful calm daylight, detailed textures and authentic practical work. Full main subjects comfortably inside frame with 10% breathing room, no cut-off key objects; use the complete square image area. Keep the bottom 15% quieter for a website caption overlay. This is an illustrative process scene, not a claim that the location or people shown are a specific real company. No watermarks, decorative seals, fake certificates, UI, floating icons, advertising captions, overdone bokeh, dramatic fog or sci-fi machinery. No invented official credentials or regulatory stamps.
Subject: in-house manufacturing and quality care. A clean modern healthcare packaging room in India, two technicians in clean white coats, blue hairnets, properly fitted masks and blue gloves. One technician carefully inspecting a sealed medical pouch on a stainless steel packing counter; second operator checking a batch tray in the middle background. Stainless steel equipment, clean white walls and glass partitions, practical bright room. See enough room and equipment to understand manufacturing; no giant face close-up. Waist-up balanced framing, work counter and product tray clearly visible. Image 1 is a reference for the authentic equipment and work setting only, do not copy the people. Image 2 is the packaging identity reference for the white-and-green sealed CHW/Chase+ medical pouches on the counter; preserve their colours and pack proportions without inventing labels.

The reference is only for the small product carton's existing CHW/Chase+ packaging colours and identity. Natural believable office lighting and understated tactile realism.
